name: lantern-night
vibe: A night lantern festival running continuously behind the film — an ink sky, twinkling stars, a breathing moon with a halo, hill silhouettes, terracotta lanterns rising endlessly through three parallax layers, sage fireflies weaving and a water band carrying their reflections. Warm serif display on a dark house, thin bright device edges, and a lantern-glow iris that opens and closes every cut. Brand colour relights the whole festival — lanterns, glow, fireflies, water and sky. Portrait-native 9:16. Best for evening, hospitality, culture and premium-calm brands.
